enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Minor Absorption
enchants.text: Has a 2% chance per hit of giving you 10 points of damage absorption. Cannot occur more often than once every 5 sec.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Insight
enchants.text: A chance to grant Insight when you cast a spell, increasing Spirit by 100% for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Recovery
enchants.text: Trigger Recovery when you are Parried or Dodged, healing you for 5% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more often than once every 10 sec.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Revelation
enchants.text: A chance to trigger Revelation when a non-periodic spell fails to critically strike. Revelation grants 100% increased critical strike chance to the next spell cast. Revelation's chance to trigger is diminished as your critical strike chance increases.

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Lesser Absorption
enchants.text: Has a 5% chance per hit of giving you 25 points of damage absorption. Cannot occur more often than once every 5 sec.

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Absorption
enchants.text: Has a 25% chance per hit of giving you 50 points of damage absorption. Cannot occur more often than once every 5 sec.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Demonslaying
enchants.text: A chance of stunning and doing heavy damage to demons.

enchants.name: Enchant Boots - Minor Speed
enchants.text: Give a slight movement speed increase.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Riding Skill
enchants.text: Grant a minor movement bonus while mounted.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Fiery Weapon
enchants.text: Often strike for 40 additional fire damage.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Icy Chill
enchants.text: Often chill the target reducing their movement and attack speed.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Lotus Claw
enchants.text: Give a small chance to acquire Death Lotus when gathering any herb in Hyjal.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Unholy Weapon
enchants.text: Often inflict a curse on the target reducing their melee damage.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Stealth
enchants.text: Give an increase to your stealth as if you were 1 level higher.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Subtlety
enchants.text: Decrease threat caused by the wearer by 2%.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Crusader
enchants.text: Often when attacking in melee it heals for 100 and increases Strength by 100 for 15 sec.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Lifestealing
enchants.text: Often steal life from the enemy and give it to the wielder.
